Send a Message via a Mattermost Incoming Webhook (Alias)

mm_send_webhook.Rd

Alias for send_webhook_message providing a consistent mm_* prefix alongside mm_get_channel_posts.

Usage

mm_send_webhook(
  webhook_url,
  text = NULL,
  channel = NULL,
  username = NULL,
  icon_url = NULL,
  icon_emoji = NULL,
  attachments = NULL,
  props = NULL,
  priority = NULL,
  timeout = 10,
  max_tries = 3
)

Arguments

webhook_url

The full incoming webhook URL (e.g. "https://mattermost.example.com/hooks/xxx-generatedkey-xxx"). Treat this as a secret.

text

Markdown-formatted message text. Required unless attachments is provided.

channel

Optional. Override the channel the message posts in. Use the channel's short name (e.g. "town-square"), not the display name. Use "@username" to send a direct message.

username

Optional. Override the username the message posts as. Requires the server setting Enable integrations to override usernames to be enabled.

icon_url

Optional. Override the profile picture with an image URL. Requires the server setting Enable integrations to override profile picture icons to be enabled.

icon_emoji

Optional. Override the profile picture with an emoji (e.g. ":robot:"). Takes precedence over icon_url.

attachments

Optional. A list of message attachment objects for richer formatting. Required if text is not provided.

props

Optional. A named list of extra properties for the post. Supports the card key for additional Markdown shown in the right-hand side panel.

priority

Optional. A list specifying message priority (e.g. list(priority = "important")).

timeout

Numeric. Request timeout in seconds (default 10).

max_tries

Integer. Maximum number of retry attempts on transient HTTP failures (default 3).

Value

The httr2 response object, returned invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
mm_send_webhook(
  webhook_url = "https://mattermost.example.com/hooks/xxx-generatedkey-xxx",
  text = "Hello from MattermostR!"
)
} # }
